concerns.text: T103 requires `local_lattice_strain` 'from the post-relaxation interface', but GB relaxation is performed in T104 (`simulate_energy.py`, 'leave-one-out segregation energies with ASE on the relaxed GB supercells'). T103 runs BEFORE T104 per the stated execution order (T103 → T104), so the post-relaxation structure T103 consumes does not exist yet — a consumer-before-producer dependency. Either move relaxation into T103/gb_builder, or split local_lattice_strain computation into a task after T104.

T105 says 'Wire the result into `results/metrics.json` `eam_validation` block', but metrics.json is first produced by T108 (which validates it against output.schema.yaml). T105 precedes T108 in the execution order, so it cannot write into a file T108 creates. Clarify that T105 only emits `data/processed/potential_validation.json` and T108 assembles metrics.json, or reorder.
